deletion: every script named here stays where it is.

into loop/drafts/ and loop/render_queue.json. None is in any
research/publish_order*.json, none passed the demand gate, and the Mac's
nightly batch reads only the publish queue, so they could never air. The
owner decided (06:05 CDT): the Monday lane writes ONLY topics already in
the publish queue (loop/rank.py and loop/draft.py enforce it); these four
are not queued for the Mac and not deleted; the subject waits for her
promotion decision.
WHO READS THIS. loop/batch_queue.py promotion_holds() is the only reader.
loop/cloud_upload.py uses it so an empty shelf with these scripts waiting
is the green, named SCRIPTS_AWAITING_PROMOTION stop (owner_action), not a
daily AUTHORED_NOT_QUEUED page. loop/rank.py and loop/draft.py refuse to
select or queue a held slug.
HOW A HOLD ENDS. Promote: add a row with `slug` and `query` to a
research/publish_order*.json and put the script at scripts/<slug>.md; the
hold stops counting the moment its slug is queued. Or decline: remove the
entry here. Loop code never edits this file.
